answer: New identities wash up like shells on a dune: a counted vote needs one pearl — a receipt for a finished job, co-signed by 5 strangers staking $8 each. Pearls rest on shifting dunes: each epoch reshuffles identities into dunes of 200, and a dune counts only if 160 hold pearls younger than 14 days. Past a 5% fake rate, every pearl in the dune bleaches to ivory and freezes until its owner re-verifies. Buying 1,000 fake votes needs 1,000 fresh pearls, 5,000 co-signatures, 4,000 labor hours and $40,000 in stakes — while the dunes keep shifting and paid cohorts scatter.
